Verified read-only 2026-10-05 on cog-pwvzk3t22wttm (eastus2): version 2026-07-07 is available as GlobalStandard with 10 units of quota unused (gpt-realtime-2.1's own quota on this account is 46/46 used, 36 of it by the old cog-axgpampkq3yfa that #88 deletes).
